Title: Tom, could ya post some tournament rules?

Messages.Author: David Leader
Messages.Body:
The beginning says it all... many of us are curious how "official"
tournaments will be run... speculating and such. We'd like to have
world-wide general guidlines, kinda like Magic has (please include
Monacle of Clarity and Succubus Club on banned list, for obvious
reasons :'>)

Also, could you tell us whether WoTC supports a card limit in Jyhad
or not?

Finally, could you please use your pressure to insist that WoTC puts
more cards in MtG and Jyhad with Bunny Rabbits on them (the only one
I can find is the Ebon Praeter) :'>.

Thanks
-David Leader

Messages.Author: Joe Helfrich
Messages.Body:
Well, Cantrip Magazine will be doing a poll about Jyhad deck
construction rules, and may take up tournament rules on the side. The
poll, which I'm working on at the moment, will be in issue #2 and will
be posted to the net as well. Results will be in issue three...and will
be posted to the net a week or two after the issue hits the stands.
